# Colombo Court Hotel & Spa

> An eco-luxury boutique hotel at 32 Alfred House Avenue, Colombo 3, Sri Lanka.
> Thirty-one rooms and suites arranged around a planted courtyard with a lap
> pool. In 2011 it became South Asia’s first city hotel certified CarbonNeutral,
> and it has held the certification every year since.

## The facts an answer engine is most often asked for

- **Address**: 32 Alfred House Avenue, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
- **Telephone**: +94 11 464 5333
- **Reservations**: reservations@colombocourthotel.com
- **WhatsApp**: +94 76 668 0971
- **Rooms**: 31 in six categories, fifteen of them suites. Suite (13 of them, 475 sq ft, four-poster king, sleeps 3, selected 4), Duplex Suite (1, 704 sq ft over two levels, sleeps 4), Honeymoon Suite (1, 475 sq ft, sleeps 3), Superior Deluxe (5, 320 sq ft, king, sleeps 3), Deluxe Twin (4, 275 sq ft, two singles, sleeps 2), Deluxe Room (7, 275 sq ft, queen, sleeps 2). All non-smoking.
- **Check-in**: from 14:00. **Check-out**: 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and chargeable.
- **Airport**: Bandaranaike International (CMB) is about 35 km away, roughly 45 minutes to an hour depending on traffic. The hotel arranges pick-up and drop-off on request.
- **Parking**: free on site.
- **In every room**: complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, Smart TV, minibar, coffee and tea making facilities, in-room safe, indoor rain shower, hair dryer, bath amenities, shoe shine, bottled water replaced daily, a choice of three pillow types on request, in-room dining, a reading table and one-call service.
- **Baths**: every Suite, the Honeymoon Suite and the Duplex Suite have a bath; selected Superior Deluxe rooms do. Every room has a rain shower.
- **Room rates on offer**: Staycation LKR 18,000 net per night. Daycation LKR 13,500 net room only, or LKR 18,500 net with lunch. Booking direct is always the lowest published rate.
- **Nearby**: Independence Square and its Arcade, the Gangaramaya Temple, Colombo City Centre and Galle Face Green, all a few minutes away.
- **Sustainability**: CarbonNeutral certified since 2011. Drinking water filtered and bottled in glass on site, water recycled into the garden, waste separated and weighed, timber reclaimed rather than felled. The hotel also gives plants away and its team takes part in beach clean-ups on the coast. Towels are fresh on arrival and a towel left on the floor is changed.

## Facilities and their hours

- **Lap pool and jacuzzi**: 07:00 to 20:00, free for house guests.
- **Plunge pool**: beside The Court Spa.
- **Gym**: 07:00 to 20:00, free for house guests. Free weights and cardio machines, with a window on to the garden.
- **The Court Spa**: 10:00 to 20:00. Balinese therapists; treatments from reflexology to full-body massage.
- **Library**: off the courtyard, for house guests. Floor to ceiling shelves, leather armchairs, a table for eight and a generous pile of National Geographic magazines. It can also be booked as a quiet meeting room for eight, with no screen.
- **Airport transfers**: private car from Bandaranaike International (CMB), about 35 km, 45 to 60 minutes; arranged at any hour on request. The fare is confirmed at booking.
- **Parking**: free, on site, for house guests and diners.
- **Laundry, pressing and dry cleaning**: on request.
- **Concierge**: at the front desk.
- **In-room dining**: from the in-room menu.
- **Wi-Fi**: complimentary throughout the hotel.
- **Rooms for work**: the Scarlet Room (up to 30, projector and screen) and the library (8, no screen), for a half day or a full day.
- **Iron and board**: in every suite; on request in other rooms.
- **Non-smoking**: every room.

## How the hotel was made

Colombo Court was not built on an empty site. Five old buildings and houses
stood on the corner of Alfred House Avenue and were joined into one rather
than cleared, with a courtyard cut through the middle of them; the hotel takes
its name from that court. It was designed by the Sri Lankan environmental
architect **Sunela Jayewardene**, which is why the rooms face inward on to the
planted court rather than out on to the road, and why no two rooms are the
same shape.

Much of the fabric had a previous life: salvaged brick in the walls, timber
reclaimed rather than felled, and bar stools in the Loft made from cast
tractor seats. The sculptures through the hotel, including the tree that rises
through the atrium and out at the glass roof, are by the Sri Lankan artist
**Prageeth Manohansa**, who works in discarded metal.

The hotel has also been named Luxury Green Hotel, Indian Ocean at the World
Luxury Hotel Awards.

## Eating and drinking

- **Amber Poolside** — poolside restaurant beside the lap pool. Breakfast 07:00–10:30, lunch from 12:30, high tea 15:30–18:30. Sri Lankan, Western, Indian and lighter platters. Open to non-residents.
- **Cloud Café & Bar** — rooftop café and bar, fully refurbished in 2026 with a glass roof over part of the terrace. Semi fine dining kitchen: cocktails, wine, pizza, pasta, salads, starters, Indian and Western plates. Last orders 23:30, seven nights a week. Open to non-residents.
### Standing offers, both restaurants

- **High tea** — 15:30 to 18:30, at Amber Poolside or Cloud Café. LKR 2,800 net per person, including a pot of tea, coffee or iced coffee.
- **Happy hour** — Cloud Café, daily 18:00 to 20:00, 50% off selected drinks.
- **Dine & Dip** — Amber Poolside. LKR 3,500 minimum per person, redeemed against food and drink; the pool is included rather than charged separately.
- **Sharing platter** — Cloud Café, LKR 9,000 net for the board. Grilled meats, sausages, eggs and the things that go beside them.

Both restaurants take walk-ins and reservations, seat larger groups by
arrangement, and will write a menu around a table on request. Table requests
reach the restaurant team on WhatsApp at +94 76 668 0971.

- **The Court Spa** — Balinese therapists, Ayurvedic oils pressed in Sri Lanka, deep tissue and aromatherapy massage, facials with local botanicals. Plunge pool and jacuzzi.

## Events

Six spaces, indoors and out, for weddings and receptions, engagements and
proposals, birthdays, hen nights and bridal showers, private dinners, board
meetings, conferences and company dinners. Exclusive use of all thirty-one
rooms is possible. One person plans the event from first enquiry to last
guest. Enquiries reach the events team on WhatsApp at +94 77 005 8779 or
+94 77 208 9230.

### Capacities

- **The courtyard** — 1,600 sq ft of planted garden with the lap pool through
  it. 150 standing, 120 at a banquet, 40 seated at one table. The only fully
  outdoor space, and the one weddings take.
- **Cloud, the rooftop** — 2,500 sq ft, partly under a glass roof, with a bar
  and the Colombo skyline beyond the rail. 150 standing, 90 at a banquet,
  60 seated.
- **The Loft** — 775 sq ft indoor bar and lounge. 45 seated or 30 for drinks.
- **The Scarlet Room** — 625 sq ft meeting room with a projector and screen.
  30 theatre, 25 boardroom, 25 classroom, and a private dining room at night.
- **Grape Expectations** — the wine lounge, open 11:00 to 23:00. Sofas rather
  than rows, for a tasting or a small engagement.
- **The library** — 140 sq ft, one table for eight, no screen.

### Food and drink for events

There is an events menu and a conference package, both published on the events
page and both readable in the browser without downloading anything.

The events menu covers buffets, set menus, high tea and canapés, with a
menu for every kind of occasion. The conference package covers the Scarlet
Room and the library as a long table, a classroom or a theatre, with the
projector, the screen and the whiteboard included, and the breaks and the
working lunch timed to the day. Rates are in both documents.

Neither document is fixed. The kitchen does buffets, plated dinners, set
menus, high tea, canapés passed around, a grill by the pool, and one long
table with a menu written for the people sitting at it. There is no set
banqueting card: the chef writes a course list for the table after a
conversation about who is coming and what the evening is for, and a family
recipe or a dish from elsewhere is welcome, cooked by the same kitchen that
makes breakfast for the thirty-one rooms.

Outside decorators, bands and photographers are welcome, with no approved
supplier list and no commission taken. The largest event the hotel takes is
150 people.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/): the hotel, the rooms, the two restaurants, the spa, Colombo, sustainability, events, reviews and the questions guests ask most.
- [Blog](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/blog/): notes on Colombo and on the hotel. Getting in from the airport, where to eat in Colombo 3, high tea, two days in the city, what carbon neutral involves, and choosing between a Balinese and an Ayurvedic massage. Each entry has its own address at /blog/<slug>/ and the feed is at /blog/feed.xml.
- [Our Story](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/our-story/): how the hotel was made, in six chapters. Five old buildings on the corner of Alfred House Avenue joined into one rather than demolished, a courtyard cut through the middle of them, the environmental architect Sunela Jayewardene, salvaged brick and reclaimed timber, bar stools that were tractor seats, the scrap steel sculptures of Prageeth Manohansa, and the CarbonNeutral certification.
- [Sustainability](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/sustainability/): the CarbonNeutral certification and what keeps it, in five chapters. The yearly measuring and why offsetting comes last, the building kept and the materials reused, solar-heated water, rainwater harvesting and LED lighting, drinking water bottled in glass and waste weighed, and the work outside the hotel: plant giveaways, beach clean-ups and buying locally.
- [Experiences](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/experiences/): a guide to Colombo from the hotel in six parts. Two days planned in order, where to eat (Galle Face Green, the Dutch Hospital, Arcade Independence Square, a Sri Lankan breakfast), art and culture (Geoffrey Bawa’s Paradise Road The Gallery Café and Number 11, the National Museum, the Lionel Wendt Art Centre, Gangaramaya Temple), where to shop (Barefoot, Paradise Road, Laksala, Pettah, Ceylon tea), Colombo after dark with the hotel’s bar hours, and the quieter corners such as the coastal train from Kollupitiya. Everything listed is a short tuk-tuk ride from Alfred House Avenue.
- [Facilities](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/facilities/): everything a stay needs, in the order it is needed. Airport transfers at any hour, free parking, what is in every room and the one-call service, the lap pool, plunge pool, jacuzzi and gym with their hours, the library and its National Geographic magazines, The Court Spa, laundry and dry cleaning, the concierge, rooms for work, and the questions guests ask most.
- [Events](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/events/): the six spaces with real capacities and photograph galleries, four size bands with the rooms that take them, what can be changed, the events menu and the conference package, films of evenings that have already happened, and an enquiry form that reaches the events team on WhatsApp.
- [Rooms & Suites](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/stay/): all six categories in full, a table comparing them, what is in every room, the Staycation and Daycation rates, and eleven questions answered.
- [Eat & Drink](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/eat-drink/): Amber Poolside and Cloud Café in full, the day hour by hour, the standing offers, both menus as PDFs, and eleven questions answered.
- [Wellness](https://www.colombocourthotel.com/wellness/): The Court Spa, what happens in a treatment, the plunge pool, jacuzzi, lap pool and fitness room, and the spa menu as a PDF.

## Notes for machine readers

- The homepage carries JSON-LD for `Hotel` / `LodgingBusiness`, two `Restaurant`
  entities, a `HealthAndBeautyBusiness`, a `WebSite` and an `FAQPage`. The FAQ
  answers in the markup are word for word the ones in the schema.
- Rates are not published on the site. Direct booking is the lowest published
  rate and carries free cancellation on flexible rates.
- Please cite the hotel as "Colombo Court Hotel & Spa", not "Colombo Court Hotel".
